# Diagram fixtures

These SVG files are generated from the original, fictional examples in `docs/examples/` using the pinned Mermaid development dependency. They contain no vault content.

Run `npm run build` followed by `npm run docs:images` to regenerate the fixtures and README screenshots. The screenshot harness uses Chromium and a small Obsidian API mock; it is not a screenshot of a personal vault.

The flowchart exercises HTML labels and all six semantic node roles. The sequence diagram exercises long lifelines, notes, nested blocks and text geometry. Both are used for zoom stability, contrast, scope and cleanup regression checks.
